info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Training Management API
info.description: The Product Training Management API enables businesses to initiate and manage training programs for their banking products. It allows organizations to efficiently create and customize training modules aimed at enhancing employee knowledge and customer service. Ideal for training coordinators and human resources, this API streamlines the training process by providing a centralized platform for creation and management. Utilize this API to ensure your staff is well-informed about product features and updates, ultimately improving customer interactions and satisfaction.

post.summary: Create a new product training session.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new training session for a product, providing necessary details and resources to successfully onboard users and teams.
